Ask Zscaler
Zscaler Client Connector Supported Versions

Zscaler supports the latest software version and the two previous versions for each software product. For Zscaler Client Connector, Zscaler also supports the current Long-Term Support (LTS) version. In some cases, Zscaler might designate another version as a supported version. To learn more about LTS, see Zscaler Client Connector Long-Term Support.

The following endpoint application versions are currently supported based on the OS:

Windows
macOS
Linux
iOS
Android
Android on ChromeOS

Zscaler limits the enrollment of devices or the transmission to the Zscaler cloud from unsupported releases. To learn more, see the Deprecation of Enrollment for Outdated Zscaler Client Connector Releases trust post.

View a list of unsupported legacy Zscaler Client Connector releases and the OS version compatibility.

The End-of-Life (EOL) for ZscalerOS 24 is on December 31, 2026.

Internet & SaaS Virtual Service Edge and NSS on Azure Supported Versions
